field.label: OpenVPN instance
field.help: The OpenVPN server instance to protect with SSO. Leave that instance's Authentication field empty; the required 'management-client-auth' directive is added automatically when you save (see Advanced).

field.label: Tenant ID
field.help: Entra ID directory (tenant) GUID or tenant domain; used to derive the issuer URL.

field.label: Custom issuer URL
field.help: Overrides the issuer derived from the tenant ID. Leave empty for Entra ID; set to connect a different OIDC provider (e.g. https://idp.example.com).

field.label: Client ID
field.help: Application (client) ID of the app registration. For Entra ID this is a GUID; other OIDC providers may use any identifier.

field.label: Client secret
field.help: Client secret of the app registration. Leave empty for a public client (PKCE). Note the expiry date: Entra secrets are valid for at most 24 months.

field.label: Scopes
field.help: Space-separated OIDC scopes requested from the provider.

field.label: Allowed groups
field.help: Entra ID group object IDs allowed to connect. Empty allows every authenticated user.

field.label: Match IP address
field.help: Require the browser session and the VPN client to come from the same IP address. Breaks logins when browser and VPN client take different network paths (e.g. CGNAT).

field.label: Pending-auth timeout (s)
field.help: How long a client may take to finish the browser login.

field.label: Public base URL
field.help: URL the user's browser reaches the firewall on, e.g. https://vpn.example.nl:9443; it must match DNS and the certificate, and be registered as redirect URI base in Entra.

field.label: Listen address
field.help: Local IPv4 or IPv6 address the callback listener binds to.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: TCP port of the callback listener; remember the matching firewall rule and the redirect URI registered in Entra. Do not use 9000: OPNsense's php-fpm already listens there.

field.label: Encryption secret
field.help: Random secret of exactly 16, 24 or 32 alphanumeric characters. Encrypts the browser state cookies and stored refresh tokens.

field.label: Enable TLS
field.help: Serve the callback listener over HTTPS (required by several VPN clients).

field.label: Certificate
field.help: Server certificate from the OPNsense trust store for the HTTPS listener.

field.label: Repair OpenVPN instance flag
field.help: Add the required 'management-client-auth' directive to the selected instance when it is missing, and restart that instance. The instance's Options field does not offer this directive and silently drops it whenever the instance is saved, so without this repair SSO stops working after any edit of the instance. Note that the repair restarts the OpenVPN instance, dropping its active tunnels.

field.label: GUI status pass-through
field.help: Keep VPN > OpenVPN > Connection Status working by proxying the management socket. Disable ("exclusive mode") only if the socket swap misbehaves.
